What does Dengage do?

Dengage is a customer data and engagement platform that helps organizations collect, manage, segment, and activate customer data for digital communication and marketing engagement purposes.

From a security and privacy perspective, Dengage is designed to support secure handling of customer data throughout the service lifecycle. The platform operates under an information security and privacy governance framework aligned with recognized standards such as SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO 22301.

Dengage applies technical and organizational controls to protect customer data, including access control, encryption, monitoring, vulnerability management, change management, incident response, vendor risk management, business continuity, and data protection practices. These controls are intended to help maintain the confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy of customer data processed through the platform.

Dengage acts as a data processor and processes personal data on behalf of its customers in accordance with contractual obligations and documented customer instructions.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=eu2s5857ieca4tbf0z6h04

What is Dengage’s role in relation to customer personal data?

Dengage acts as a data processor, processing personal data on behalf of its customers and in accordance with their documented instructions. Dengage customers remain the data controllers responsible for determining the purposes and means of processing. Dengage applies appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data and supports customers in meeting their applicable data protection obligations.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=r6vngb1eeyg4ebg64ibau9

Where is customer data hosted?

Customer data is hosted in approved cloud environments and regions based on contractual, operational, and regulatory requirements. Dengage can provide additional information on hosting locations upon request.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=06dh67bksy5xrh7lk994gy

What security and compliance frameworks does Dengage follow?

Dengage operates an information security and privacy management program aligned with recognized frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, and ISO 22301.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=82qgyloyoxugv9385tjvpp

Has Dengage completed a SOC 2 Type II examination?

Yes. Dengage has completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering the design and operating effectiveness of relevant security controls over the defined audit period.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=xh4vwv2585wqksp5z7z7uq

How can customers access Dengage’s SOC 2 report or ISO certificates?

Customers may request access through Dengage’s Trust Center. Access to confidential compliance documents may require approval and, where applicable, an NDA.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=3n0635owaty8pec1y1rxe

How does Dengage protect personal data?

Dengage applies privacy and security controls designed to protect personal data, including access controls, encryption, data minimization, retention controls, and internal privacy governance.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=kku9pb0sfjh2s7ygprjyi

Is Dengage compliant with GDPR and other privacy regulations?

Dengage maintains privacy practices aligned with applicable data protection requirements, including GDPR where relevant to its services and customers.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=m9cksm989xyd2aw23jtkr

Does Dengage support data subject rights requests?

Yes. Dengage supports customers in responding to applicable data subject rights requests in accordance with contractual obligations and applicable data protection laws.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=aixvdoyvjujzp12st29u47

How long does Dengage retain customer data?

Customer data retention depends on contractual terms, service configuration, legal requirements, and applicable retention policies. Dengage supports deletion or retention actions in accordance with agreed requirements.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=y4nugrdevygkqu58ovt53y

How does Dengage securely delete data?

Dengage applies controlled deletion, lifecycle management, backup retention controls, and encryption-based compensating controls where physical overwriting is not technically feasible.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=hptb2n5bxp8juev52opmfo

Does Dengage encrypt customer data?

Yes. Dengage applies encryption controls for customer data both in transit and at rest, using industry-standard encryption mechanisms and secure key management practices.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=1y5flglfid1ent8ayauzr7

Does Dengage use multi-factor authentication?

Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for access to critical systems and administrative accounts.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=hrebg571werx1d7c162tr

How does Dengage manage employee access to systems and data?

Access is granted based on role, business need, and least privilege principles. Access rights are reviewed periodically and removed or updated when no longer required.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=z2sx6vyfiapr1ah7blohiy

Does Dengage monitor its systems?

Yes. Dengage monitors critical systems and infrastructure to support availability, security event detection, and operational response.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=tqa9ffp5yivbi85jdczib

Does Dengage perform background checks for employees?

Dengage performs background screening in accordance with applicable local laws, role requirements, and internal policy.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=ufm266qhweklfjnp7ol3zu

Does Dengage provide security awareness training?

Yes. Employees complete security and privacy awareness training, including topics such as data protection, secure remote work, phishing, password security, and incident reporting.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=4njjdvgrrkicwggvndm5o

How does Dengage handle vulnerability management?

Dengage performs vulnerability management activities including scanning, assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and validation based on risk.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=xayp6c4sot2jh6un47yidy

Does Dengage perform penetration testing?

Dengage conducts security testing activities as part of its security program. Relevant summaries or attestations may be shared with customers under appropriate confidentiality conditions.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=d3kxemje78gn0563h4h1pl

Does Dengage have an incident response process?

Yes. Dengage maintains an incident response process covering identification, escalation, investigation, containment, remediation, and customer notification where required.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=vbt7k9oaql3tzui5uzm70b

Does Dengage have business continuity and disaster recovery plans?

Yes. Dengage maintains business continuity and disaster recovery practices designed to support service resilience and recovery in the event of disruption.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=ezv3zyt8z9n9chrezgpjj0

Where can customers check Dengage’s service status?

Customers can monitor Dengage’s current service status, availability updates, and incident notifications through the Dengage Status Page: https://status.dengage.net

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=mf8czczu1i7as9x6aukd8l

How does Dengage manage changes to production systems?

Production changes are managed through a formal change management process, including review, approval, testing, risk assessment, implementation tracking, and rollback planning where applicable.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=252bh7g7kswzf9q414i75

Does Dengage use subcontractors or third-party service providers?

Yes. Dengage may use selected third-party service providers to support its services. Third-party risks are assessed and managed through vendor due diligence, contractual controls, and periodic review.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=8gsv25j2chmp106bmvx0a

Who can customers contact for security or compliance questions?

Customers may contact Dengage through their account representative or the designated security and compliance contact channel for requests related to security, privacy, audit reports, and compliance documentation.

https://trust.dengage.com/faq?s=lboclq3l2ttnvxlwchy6p2
